description: Combine 2 to 6 cards already produced in THIS reply into ONE dashboard card. First call the data tools (or show_card) and read the "id" of each returned card (c1, c2, ...), then pass those ids in card_ids in display order. Optional captions: one short line per card, same order and length as card_ids (use an empty text to skip), copied from tool results; never invent numbers. columns: 1 for line or bar charts with many points, 2 only for small kpi or bar panels. At most 1 dashboard per reply and at most 4 rows. The dashboard replaces the individual cards in the reply.

parameters.label: Card Ids
parameters.description: 2 to 6 card ids (c1, c2, ...) from the "id" field of cards returned by tools in this reply, in display order.

parameters.label: Subtitle
parameters.description: Optional, e.g. the period. Up to 90 characters.

parameters.label: Subtext
parameters.description: Optional second line, up to 100 characters.

parameters.label: Columns
parameters.description: 1 for line/bar charts with many points; 2 only for small kpi/bar panels. Default 2.

parameters.label: Captions
parameters.description: Optional: one short caption per card, same order and length as card_ids; empty text to skip. Copy from tool results.
